description: Privacy release migrations in apply order. Checked by scripts/release-preflight.mjs; regenerate with --write-manifest --from <version> and review the diff.

release_range.chosen_because: Runbook section 2 step 0a (20261103100000) is the first migration of the privacy release. Section 1's first unledgered file (20260915214000) is not used: the 71 files from 20260915214000 to 20261030120000 are already in production by catalog evidence but have no ledger rows, and 20260926155719 is ledgered after them, so a range starting there would always look like a gap and would list historical files as pending. Their ledger rows are a separate owner decision, and historical files must never be re-run.

generated.method: full local replay (stub + every earlier migration), catalog snapshot before the range and after each release file; states are md5(pg_get_functiondef) and md5 of pg_policies qual/with_check/cmd+permissive+roles, keyed by Postgres major (null = absent). expect_before = before the range, expect_steps[v] = after defining migration v, expect_after = after the whole range. Hashes are never compared across majors; add another major with --merge-hashes.

known_unledgered_basis: Runbook section 1 / docs/migration-history-reconciliation.md section 3: these historical files are in production by catalog evidence (docs/migration-evidence/ledger-evidence.csv) but have no ledger row. Only they may lack one; the sha256 is the reviewed file.

policies.policy: Sender, released recipient or guardian can read
Host and linked players read payment settings
Hosts manage own game payment settings (insert)
Hosts manage own game payment settings (update)
Authorized people read exact game location
Gym admins view reviews about their gym
Public reviews are viewable by everyone
